# DRAFT: Medical device adverse incident report

> This is a draft for human review. It has not been submitted. A manufacturer would report
> through the MHRA MORE portal; healthcare professionals and users report through the Yellow Card scheme.

## 1. Device
- Name: ClinicDrift-monitored DR screening model
- Version: v1.0
- Intended use: screening retinal photographs for referable diabetic retinopathy

## 2. Where and when
- Clinic: IN-IDR-01 (India)
- Period: week 1 (starting 2026-01-05)

## 3. What happened
ClinicDrift found that this clinic's scans no longer resemble the scans the AI was validated on (drift score 0.96, where 0.5 means like training and 1 clearly different).
Its sensitivity for referable disease therefore cannot be verified from 25 scans from this week, and expert grades for these scans have not yet arrived. The AI is referring more patients than usual: 96% of this week's scans, compared with 68% of the training scans.

## 4. Potential patient impact
Because the catch rate cannot be verified, the number of possibly missed cases is not estimated. No patient harm has been confirmed.

## 5. Likely cause
The clinic is producing images with significantly altered contrast, reduced sharpness, and much higher resolution compared with training data, leading to a drift alarm and an elevated referral rate. (category: camera or image quality; confidence 95%; source: gemini)

Evidence:
- Drift score is 0.96, indicating scans no longer look like training data
- Mean contrast changed from 0.0963 to 0.0733 (-0.238 relative change)
- Mean sharpness changed from 0.000399 to 0.000227 (-0.431 relative change)
- Mean quality changed from 0.5 to 0.284 (-0.433 relative change)
- Mean resolution changed from 1020.0 px to 4290.0 px (3.191 relative change)
- Referral rate increased from 0.685 to 0.96 (+40.2%)

## 6. Action
ClinicDrift paused the AI at this clinic because its scans have drifted beyond what the AI was validated on, meaning its catch rate cannot be verified. We recommend sending this clinic's scans for human grading until the checks below are complete.

Checks:
- [ ] Inspect the camera lens and sensor for smudges or dust
- [ ] Verify camera settings and resolution output configurations
- [ ] Review technician image acquisition protocols for focus and alignment

## 7. Regulatory context
- Post-market surveillance (PMS): this alarm is part of ongoing monitoring of the device in use.
- Predetermined change control plan (PCCP): any model change made in response should fall within an agreed PCCP.
- MHRA AI Airlock Phase 2 report: see recommendations 3 and 4.

## 8. MIT AI Risk Repository tags
- 7.3 AI system safety, failures & limitations > Lack of capability or robustness
- 1.3 Discrimination & toxicity > Unequal performance across groups
- 5.1 Human-computer interaction > Overreliance and unsafe use
